title: Improving the XGBoost Model through Hyperparameter Selection

cues.en: Welcome to Section three Training, a supervised learning model.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到第三章：訓練監督式學習模型。

cues.en: This is Lecture 12 Improving the Xgboost model through hyper parameter selection.
cues.zh: 這是第十二堂課：透過超參數選擇改善 XGBoost 模型。

cues.en: So if we pick up where we left off in lecture 11, we made use of a xgboost classifier out of the box.
cues.zh: 接續第十一堂課，我們使用了預設設定的 XGBoost 分類器。

cues.en: So it was a baseline model.
cues.zh: 也就是基準模型。

cues.en: We didn't supply any hyper parameters to the implementation.
cues.zh: 實作時沒有額外指定超參數。

cues.en: In this case, what I've done is I've now trained the xgboost classifier with the scale weight hyper parameter set to 100.
cues.zh: 這次我把 scale_pos_weight 超參數設為 100，重新訓練 XGBoost 分類器。

cues.en: So you can think of this as equivalent to the classweight hyper parameter that we made use of with the
cues.zh: 你可以把它想成類似於邏輯斯迴歸模型中使用的

cues.en: logistic regression model where we are going to be penalizing misclassifications of the positive class
cues.zh: class_weight 超參數，讓正類的錯誤分類

cues.en: more severely by a factor of 100 at training time, hence telling the model, you know, pay more attention to the positive class, which is, you know, positive fraud.
cues.zh: 在訓練時受到 100 倍的懲罰，等於告訴模型要更重視正類，也就是詐欺。

cues.en: It's the minority class and we just upscaling it by a factor of 100.
cues.zh: 它是少數類別，而我們把它的權重提高 100 倍。

cues.en: Then once I've trained the model, making predictions, printing out the confusion matrix, and again,
cues.zh: 訓練完成後，做出預測，再輸出混淆矩陣，同樣可以看到

cues.en: we can see we're getting quite good results with the xgboost classifier.
cues.zh: XGBoost 分類器的結果相當不錯。

cues.en: We've got
cues.zh: 我們多抓到了

cues.en: one.
cues.zh: 一筆。

cues.en: I think in the first baseline implementation we detected 40 instances of fraud.
cues.zh: 我記得最初的基準模型偵測到了 40 筆詐欺。

cues.en: Here we've got 41 but slightly more misclassifications from a false positive perspective.
cues.zh: 這裡則是 41 筆，不過偽陽性也稍微增加了一些。

cues.en: So yeah, I guess that's a good result, but we are able to improve it slightly.
cues.zh: 所以結果算不錯，但還可以再改善一點。

cues.en: So let's look at what else we can do in a second iteration of hyper parameter tuning for the Xgboost model.
cues.zh: 看看第二輪 XGBoost 超參數調整還能做什麼。

cues.en: I'm going to keep the scaling of the positive weight hyper parameter to 100.
cues.zh: 我會讓 scale_pos_weight 繼續保持為 100。

cues.en: Then I'm also going to introduce this maximum depth hyper parameter and I'm going to set that to five.
cues.zh: 再加入 max_depth 這個超參數，把它設為 5。

cues.en: And what that effectively represents is the the maximum depth to which each of the smaller trees.
cues.zh: 它代表各棵較小決策樹的最大深度。

cues.en: Within this ensemble approach.
cues.zh: 也就是集成方法中的每一棵樹。

cues.en: It specifies how deep each of those trees will be built or how deep they will go.
cues.zh: 這個參數指定每棵樹建立時可以深入到什麼程度。

cues.en: And it's an approach to reduce overfitting as well.
cues.zh: 這也是降低過度擬合的一種方式。

cues.en: So that's something we can dial up and down.
cues.zh: 所以我們可以調高或調低它。

cues.en: We can make the maximum depth, know something like 2 or 3 if we want.
cues.zh: 如果需要，也可以把最大深度設成 2 或 3。

cues.en: Maybe there's not enough complexity there.
cues.zh: 但這樣的複雜度可能不夠。

cues.en: You know, maybe if we set it to a depth of ten, that's likely to be too deep.
cues.zh: 如果設為 10 層，又可能太深。

cues.en: We're going to experience some some level of overfitting.
cues.zh: 我們就可能遇到某種程度的過度擬合。

cues.en: So we have to find that happy medium point in conjunction with different values for the scaling of positive weights.
cues.zh: 因此，需要搭配不同的正類權重設定，找到適當的平衡點。

cues.en: So you can imagine how this becomes quite a big optimization problem because if you increase this to
cues.zh: 可以想像，這很快就會變成一個大型最佳化問題，因為如果把深度增加到

cues.en: 6 or 7 and we keep that 100 as is, you know, it might improve the model.
cues.zh: 6 或 7，而權重仍維持 100，模型可能會改善。

cues.en: And then if we drop 100 again, then maybe it reduces the performance of the model, etcetera.
cues.zh: 但如果再降低 100 這個權重，模型效能又可能下降，等等。

cues.en: So you often making trade offs with one another.
cues.zh: 所以往往必須在不同設定之間取捨。

cues.en: But what you want to do is take an approach where you can explore within reason the the universe or
cues.zh: 我們要採取的方法，是在合理範圍內探索

cues.en: the possible space of different hyper parameter configurations and then see what you, what you kind of come up with.
cues.zh: 各種可能的超參數組合空間，再觀察結果。

cues.en: And that can be run as an experiment.
cues.zh: 這可以當作一項實驗來執行。

cues.en: And like I mentioned, there are tools like Hyperopt and Optuna that allow you to, to do that.
cues.zh: 如前所述，Hyperopt、Optuna 等工具都能幫助你完成這件事。

cues.en: So once we've trained the second model, we can see that we're getting better results from a positive class classification performance.
cues.zh: 第二個模型訓練完成後，可以看到正類的分類效能更好。

cues.en: So we detecting two more fraudulent instances and we've got less false positives.
cues.zh: 它多偵測到了兩筆詐欺案例，而且偽陽性更少。

cues.en: So there's only three non fraudulent transactions that we've flagged as fraudulent, which seems like a better result.
cues.zh: 現在只有三筆非詐欺交易被誤判為詐欺，看起來是更好的結果。
